title: Maps between shapes
summary: Member-for-member maps written as source at build time. A map is an expression tree, so one declaration serves a database query and an object already in memory; every member of the shape being produced is accounted for or the build stops.
useWhen: An entity becomes a model, or one model becomes another. Do not hand-write a specification's Selector for a shape that has a map, and do not reach for a runtime mapper: a member it cannot work out is silently left empty, which is the failure this package exists to remove.
entryPoint: public sealed partial class BedMap : Map<Bed, BedModel>
